G1_feature_lineage_and_leakage.observed: 60/60 windows across 6 files verified with 0 discrepancies; across-patient scramble AUROC = 0.3689 (expected ~0.50); zero temporal look-back/look-ahead leakage verified.

G2_calibration_and_bss_audit.metric: Platt scaling fold diagnostics & Brier Skill Score
G2_calibration_and_bss_audit.observed: Root causes of calibrated AUROC collapse decomposed: within-patient AUROC is strictly preserved when beta_1 > 0; cross-patient intercept shifts (Simpson's paradox) scramble weak morphology ordering; negative slopes diagnosed in A002/F053/I082-v1. G061 BSS = +0.1526; RR-GBDT BSS = +0.6381; morphology models BSS in [-0.059, -0.047].

G3_hsmm_clinical_behavior.metric: 16 synthetic stress scenarios & validation episode audit
G3_hsmm_clinical_behavior.observed: All 16 controlled scenarios passed (0 false AF in 24h sinus, 1 episode in 24h AF, isolated 30s transient suppressed by duration prior, 6-min clinical episode resolved). Validation clinical sensitivity, PPV, and boundary errors quantified.

G4_charitos_translation_invariance.observed: Mathematical proof and numerical simulation verify true Charitos density is exactly translation-invariant across all shifts (max diff = 0.00e+00). Naive cumulative area rejected (varies 2x between edge and center). Real clinical annotation shifts replicated with zero error.

G5_single_lead_realism.observed: Eliminated 2-channel RR leakage in single-lead evaluation. Discovered severe lead-asymmetry in G061 (Lead 0 AUROC 0.9232 vs Lead 1 AUROC 0.1885). Standalone RR-GBDT maintains balanced performance across leads (0.9706 on Lead 0 vs 0.9622 on Lead 1).

G6_baseline_non_inferiority.observed: Pure morphology (A001 AUC 0.5905 raw / 0.2545 calibrated) fails non-inferiority to RR-GBDT (AUC 0.9663) by >0.35 AUROC. Multimodal G061 (AUC 0.8686) is inferior to RR-GBDT and relies almost entirely on its RR branch. Shuffling morphology in G061 leaves AUROC unchanged.
